description: This file defines a React component named MCPServerPermissions that displays MCP server permissions and access groups, including fetch logic for server details and groups, as well as UI rendering for expandable server items with tool permissions.

methods.name: MCPServerPermissions
methods.description: React functional component to display MCP server permissions with expandable details.

methods.name: getMCPServerDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a formatted display name for a MCP server given its ID.

methods.name: getAccessGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Returns display name for an access group.

methods.name: toggleServerExpansion
methods.description: Toggles expansion state for a server item.
